notes: Money: the 40-coin debt is recorded as a debt quest; no cash change was narrated, so none was needed.
Invented: the guild faction's note says 'the guild Rey was dismissed from', which has no basis in the narration or ledger.
The dueInMinutes 235 for the guild plan is a loose reading of 'by lunch', not a clear error.
The ledger secrets and plans were recorded through note_world and note_character.
The note_world entry adds that Rae's description includes a harpoon pistol that is absent from the state. This is not in the narration or the ledger, so it counts as invented.

The narration says the wreck was a 'не шторм' clue; the world note labels it an 'улика, что не случайно' (evidence it was not an accident). This matches the ledger's secrets, so it is not counted as wrong.
The quest updates describe the 40-coin debt and the half-pay split condition correctly. The state diff shows no quest changes, but the accepted calls show the updates, so I counted them as recorded.
Marta's character note, the guild character and both place updates match the narration.
The rope is recorded with the right owner, the knife-cut end and the origin under the pier.
Mokey's notes and relation were recorded. Marta waiting at the door was not recorded separately, but she is minor.
The rejected attitude call was retried without the attitude field, so nothing was lost.
The night boat plan, with dueInMinutes 885, and the clue notes match the ledger.
Three finish_turn calls are duplicates, which is harmless.
The helmet is recorded as story gear owned by the young diver, with a fresh star crack. This is correct.
All three people have records. Ремезов and Фалей have Character Models, and the young diver is recorded without a name, which matches the narration.
The first two note_world calls were rejected, but the retries with operation set were accepted. The secret about the diver's descent and the clue are therefore recorded.
The place record and move_party of 10 minutes match the narration, which says about ten minutes along the pontoons.
The quest description update is grounded in the narration. The state diff shows no quest change, but this does not matter for play.
Debts/promises: Falei's order to keep outsiders off the barge and his open question about who sent Rei are recorded in the quest journal, the plan note and Falei's character note.
People: Falei, Remezov and the young diver are all recorded as upserts with character notes; the diver's secret is in a private note.
Time: 5 minutes passed, which fits the short haggling scene.

Items: the hero's gear (only a knife and a rope scrap, no helmet, pump or harpoon gun) is captured in the quest description and the world note; the diff shows no item changes, which is correct since nothing was gained.
Money/debt: the agreement to give half of each payment toward the 40-coin debt is recorded in both quest updates and in Marta's relation note.
People: Kupchin was created with a Character Model; Marta's changed standing is in her relation note; Mokey's wait is in the world note and his presence flag.
Time: 20 minutes were recorded, against a narrated ten-minute walk plus conversation, which is within tolerance.
The narration says Mokey has a boat and strong hands, so he is the likely pump operator, and the records capture this.
The first plan_kupchin-noon call was rejected, but the retry with dueInMinutes succeeded, so nothing was left unrecorded.
Marta's attitude call was rejected, but the same content went into the relation note on the retry.
Invented: the quest description says «Качать воздух и держать лодку может Мокей; он пока не ответил». This is not in the narration or the ledger.

Invented-adjacent: the quest description also says Rey has only a knife and a piece of rope. The narration does not state this, though the ledger said not to invent items. Counted within the single invented record.
Ремезов's secret plan for the evening (18:00) was recorded with dueInMinutes 540, which is roughly right given the time now (about 12:35).
The 215 minutes (195+20) matches 3 hours of waiting plus 20 minutes of walking.
The Kupchin offer of 30 coins is recorded as an offer, with the half going to Marta. This matches the ledger.
The night boat plan (23:00) was already in force and is not a new fact.
A rejected Kupchin note rewrote his identity; the accepted second note kept the key facts, so nothing was lost.

Debts/promises: Marta gave the lard grudgingly, Mokei silently agreed to hold the boat, and Kupchin volunteered to pump. This is only partly covered in the quest description, with no separate promise or commitment recorded. Counted as a miss.
People: Mokei's agreement, Kupchin's volunteering (coat off, briefcase left on the counter) and Marta's grudging help were not recorded as updates to the NPCs. The state diff shows no NPC changes.

Items: the shoulder bruise and the hose snagged on the rudder are state facts, but they are covered in the world note, so they are not counted as item misses. The helmet was created and then lent to Rei, which is fine. The lard used was not recorded, which is minor.
Time: 135 minutes against 'almost two hours' of preparation plus getting into the boat, which is consistent.
The note_world record and the quest update match the narration and the ledger, so nothing is invented.
The secret findings (hole punched from outside, cramped storeroom behind it, cut buoy knot on the rail) are recorded in the note_world clue entry and the quest update.

The note_world entry adds the detail that a guild diver was hit by the trap, which is not in the narration, but it is flagged as not to be revealed and is consistent with the earlier clues, so it is not counted as invented.
3 minutes of game time were recorded, which matches the ledger and the scene.
The narration has no item, money, debt or person changes, so those categories have nothing to record.
Rey's bitten cheek and ringing head are not recorded as a condition, but the ledger treats them as minor; not counted as a miss.
The secret (Rey withheld the chisel hole and the buoy) and Kupchin's slip about the waterline are both recorded via note_world and the quest update.
Items: the hose damage and the helmet's location are recorded correctly.
Time: 10 minutes recorded against a ledger estimate of about 10, which matches.
Items: the helmet, pump and hose were taken to the shed and the hose hung on a nail with its hole unpatched. No item or location record was made, so this is a miss.
Money: the player paid nothing and has no money, which matches the diff showing no money change. It was noted in note_world, so this counts as recorded.

Debts/promises: Marta's debt was kept as an existing thread and the note says nothing was paid. Kupchin's promise to find the second end and dive tomorrow is not recorded as a separate promise. The thirty coins due on delivery of the box were only mentioned in the world note.
People: Brylj was created, and Remezov and Marta were updated. Kupchin's departure and standing were not recorded as a person update, but this is minor.
Places: Marta's tavern with its back door to the shed yard was not recorded as a place or detail.
Time: 180 minutes passed, matching the narration of roughly 3 hours until about 18:00.
One note_world call was rejected, but the retry succeeded, so nothing was missed because of it.
Debts_promises: Remezov's waiting deadline was recorded as a plan note with a due time (12 min vs ledger ~18:25), which is acceptable.
People: Marta's account (crew, owner, red-haired sailor) was recorded in the world note and the character note; Remezov waiting in the yard was recorded in the plan note.
Places: the wreck name «Купава» was recorded in the world note.
Time: 10 minutes passed, matching the narration. The move_party call is slightly odd, since the scene stayed in the tavern, but the place is the same tavern and the state is harmless.

Money: the 2 coins for the night were added to the debt only through the quest description; the money call was rejected and the debt amount was not recorded as a ledger entry. The state shows money {}, so the debt increase is not in the money records.

People: Brul (the lookout) and his accomplice are recorded only as a world note, with no character records. Remezov's change of standing (offended, left) is recorded in the plan note, which counts. The two night intruders and Kupchin as a neighbour have no separate Character Models.
Debts: the quest description was updated to 42, but the quest title still reads 'forty coins' (minor inconsistency).

People: the night visitors (tall stooped man and stocky lookout) were not recorded as characters, and Mokey's arrival and his identification of the alder chips were not recorded. The accepted note_world call (day2-morning-state) did not appear in the state diff, and its first attempt was rejected, so the people facts remain unrecorded.
Items: the shared 'грузы и сигнальный конец' item was removed and the weights recreated as a separate item, which is correct. The shortened hose was modified correctly.
Places: the breakwater mast description was updated correctly.

The modified pump record includes the speculation about spare couplings 'probably at Remezov's barge or in the city', which is taken from the ledger and is not invented.

The signal line was recorded as an item owned by Savely Kupchin, the original owner, although the line is still tied to the mast and not in Rey's hands. This is a small ownership oddity, not counted as wrong because the description makes the state clear.
The ledger secrets and plans (Bryl's night attempt, his return at ~23:00, Kupchin waking at ~08:00, the tide washing out the tracks at ~10:00) were recorded in note_world.
Place facts (the sand strip with tracks, the line at the mast) were recorded through upsert_place and a quest update.
20 minutes matches the narration.
The henchman was recorded as a character with an accurate description, and the clue note and quest update cover his words and actions.
Mokey hiding the boat behind the breakwater head is covered in the place record and quest update. Mokey is presumably already a known character, so no new record was needed.
The breakwater place was recorded and matches the narration. The tide start and the footprints washing away at about 10:00 come from the ledger and are consistent with it.
15 minutes were advanced, matching the narration.
The rejected upsert_character call was followed by an accepted retry, so nothing was left unrecorded.

The man on the barge and the smoke over the smokehouse are recorded in the world note, which counts as the secrets/plans record.
